anus.d: the excretory opening at the end of the alimentary canal

anu.d: Babylonian god of the sky; one of the supreme triad including Bel and Ea

anubis.d: Egyptian god of tombs and ruler of the underworld; usually depicted as a man with the head of a jackal

anuretic.d: of or relating to an inability to urinate

anunnaki.d: any of a group of powerful Babylonian earth spirits or genii; servitors of the gods

anuran.d: any of various tailless stout-bodied amphibians with long hind limbs for leaping; semiaquatic and terrestrial species
